license_required.quote: For any person, not licensed under this chapter or who has not paid the annual renewal fee as in this chapter provided to be paid, to practice optometry as defined in this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created the Indiana optometry board (referred to in this chapter as the board), whose duty it shall be to carry out this chapter.

name.quote: There is created the Indiana optometry board (referred to in this chapter as the board), whose duty it shall be to carry out this chapter.

type.quote: There is created the Indiana optometry board (referred to in this chapter as the board), whose duty it shall be to carry out this chapter. The board shall consist of five (5) members appointed by the governor.

age_minimum.quote: Applicant must be at least eighteen (18) years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Applicant must not have a conviction for: (A) an act which would constitute a ground for disciplinary sanction under IC 25-1-9; or (B) a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently.

degree_required.value: Graduate of a college of optometry with two years of preoptometry or premedicine and at least four years of optometry
degree_required.quote: Two (2) years of preoptometry or two (2) years of premedicine in a college of arts and science whose credits will be accepted by a university having a college or school of optometry, and at least four (4) years of optometry in a college of optometry using university standards.

degree_level.quote: Two (2) years of preoptometry or two (2) years of premedicine in a college of arts and science whose credits will be accepted by a university having a college or school of optometry, and at least four (4) years of optometry in a college of optometry using university standards.

school_approval_basis.quote: the board shall establish and record, in a record kept for that purpose, a schedule of the minimum requirements and rules for the recognition of schools of optometry

credential_pegged.quote: Applicant must be a graduate from a college of optometry under one (1) of the following conditions

required.quote: The minimum requirements which must be fulfilled before an applicant will be permitted to take an examination for a license to practice optometry in Indiana are as follows

experience_source.quote: Two (2) years of preoptometry or two (2) years of premedicine in a college of arts and science whose credits will be accepted by a university having a college or school of optometry, and at least four (4) years of optometry in a college of optometry using university standards.

exams.name: Examination given or approved by the board
exams.notes: Every person before beginning practice must pass an examination given or approved by the board.
exams.quote: Every person, except those exempted under this chapter, or those excepted from the taking of an examination under this chapter, before beginning the practice of optometry in this state, must pass an examination which shall be given or approved by the board.

exams.name: Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease (TMOD) examination
exams.notes: Required only for the additional certificate to administer, dispense, and prescribe legend drugs under IC 25-24-3.
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Board of Examiners in Optometry, sponsored by IAB)
exams.quote: Pass the Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease (TMOD) examination that is sponsored by the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry (IAB) and administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry.

interval_years.quote: In each even-numbered year, the Indiana professional licensing agency shall issue a ninety (90) day notice of expiration and a license renewal application

required.quote: No biennial renewal license shall be issued by the board until the applicant submits proof satisfactory to the board that subsequent to the issuance of his license, or last renewal thereof, he has completed continuing professional education

period_years.quote: No biennial renewal license shall be issued by the board until the applicant submits proof satisfactory to the board that subsequent to the issuance of his license, or last renewal thereof, he has completed continuing professional education

available.quote: Any applicant may, at the discretion of the board, be licensed if the applicant presents evidence that the applicant has been issued a license by any other state where the requirements for licensure are, in the opinion of the board, equivalent to the requirements for licensure in this state, provided that the applicant has not previously failed an examination given or approved by the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license from another state with equivalent requirements and must not have previously failed an examination given or approved by the Indiana board. Licensing at board's discretion.
requirements.quote: Any applicant may, at the discretion of the board, be licensed if the applicant presents evidence that the applicant has been issued a license by any other state where the requirements for licensure are, in the opinion of the board, equivalent to the requirements for licensure in this state, provided that the applicant has not previously failed an examination given or approved by the board.

exists.quote: There is created the Indiana optometry board (referred to in this chapter as the board), whose duty it shall be to carry out this chapter.

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
national_certification.quote: Pass the Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease (TMOD) examination that is sponsored by the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry (IAB) and administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry.

national_association.quote: adequate funds for the establishment of said program are made available by the optometrists of the state of Indiana through the Indiana Optometric Association, Inc., or otherwise.

regulatory_model.quote: For any person, not licensed under this chapter or who has not paid the annual renewal fee as in this chapter provided to be paid, to practice optometry as defined in this chapter.

credential_type.quote: All persons successfully passing the examination and meeting the requirements of the board shall be registered in a record and shall also receive a license to be signed by the president and secretary of the board.

is_mandatory.quote: For any person, not licensed under this chapter or who has not paid the annual renewal fee as in this chapter provided to be paid, to practice optometry as defined in this chapter.

title_protection.quote: For any person or persons, except a licensed optometrist or optometrists under this chapter whose licenses have not been revoked or lapsed, to hold himself out by the use of any sign, newspaper, advertisement, pamphlet, circular, or any other means as qualified to practice optometry.

scope_protection.quote: For any person, not licensed under this chapter or who has not paid the annual renewal fee as in this chapter provided to be paid, to practice optometry as defined in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Opening an office or practicing optometry without first obtaining a license from the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any person or persons to open an office for the purpose of practicing optometry in this state, or to announce to the public in any way an intention to practice optometry in any county in this state, without first having obtained a license from the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as qualified to practice optometry without a valid license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any person or persons, except a licensed optometrist or optometrists under this chapter whose licenses have not been revoked or lapsed, to hold himself out by the use of any sign, newspaper, advertisement, pamphlet, circular, or any other means as qualified to practice optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Possession of optometric instruments or selling ophthalmic lenses without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any person or persons, except a licensed optometrist or optometrists under this chapter whose licenses have not been revoked or lapsed, to have possession of any trial lenses, trial frames, graduated test cards, or other appliances or instruments used in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the optometry chapter constitutes a Class B misdemeanor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who violates this chapter commits a Class B misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse license to applicant who has been disciplined by another state's licensing entity if disciplinary action was warranted due to inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may not issue a license to an applicant who has been disciplined by the licensing entity of another state or jurisdiction, if it appears to the satisfaction of the board that the disciplinary action taken against the applicant by the licensing entity of the other state or jurisdiction was warranted due to the applicant's inability to practice optometry without endangering the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing therapeutic legend drugs without the required certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An optometrist may not: (1) administer, dispense, or prescribe therapeutic legend drugs; or (2) dispense or prescribe diagnostic legend drugs; unless the optometrist is certified under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Reckless, knowing, or intentional violation of the legend drug chapter is a Class A misdemeanor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An individual who recklessly, knowingly, or intentionally violates this chapter commits a Class A misdemeanor.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry is hereby defined to be any one of the following acts, or any combination of, or part of the following acts: (a) The examination or diagnosis of the human eye, to ascertain the presence of abnormal conditions or functions which may be diagnosed, corrected, remedied or relieved, or the application or prescription of lenses, prisms, exercises, or any physical, mechanical, physiological or psychological therapy, or the employment of any means, for the purpose of detecting any diseased or pathological condition of the eye, or the effects of any diseased or pathological condition of the eye, which may have any significance in a complete optometric diagnosis of the eye or its associated structures.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry is hereby defined to be any one of the following acts, or any combination of, or part of the following acts: (a) The examination or diagnosis of the human eye, to ascertain the presence of abnormal conditions or functions which may be diagnosed, corrected, remedied or relieved, or the application or prescription of lenses, prisms, exercises, or any physical, mechanical, physiological or psychological therapy, or the employment of any means, for the purpose of detecting any diseased or pathological condition of the eye, or the effects of any diseased or pathological condition of the eye, which may have any significance in a complete optometric diagnosis of the eye or its associated structures.

value: examination and diagnosis of the human eye
application or prescription of lenses, prisms, exercises
physical, mechanical, physiological or psychological therapy
use of optical, physiological and psychological measures
furnishing or providing prosthetic or therapeutic devices
methods_authorized.quote: The application, use, or adaption of physical, anatomical, physiological, psychological or any other principles through scientific professional methods and devices, to the examination of the eyes and vision, measuring their function for the purpose of determining the nature and degree of their departure from the normal, if any, and adopting optical, physiological and psychological measures and/or the furnishing or providing any prosthetic or therapeutic devices for the emendation thereof.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may administer topical diagnostic legend drugs (miotics, mydriatics, anesthetics, cycloplegics) without a certificate; certified optometrists may administer, dispense, or prescribe legend drugs in the formulary for treatment of eye conditions; Tramadol may be prescribed by certified optometrists with a controlled substance registration.
drug_authority.quote: The board may authorize an optometrist holding a certificate issued under this chapter to: (1) administer for therapeutic use; (2) dispense; or (3) prescribe; legend drugs that are included in the formulary established by the board under section 10 of this chapter, in the treatment of any condition of the eye or the associated structures of the eye.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the application or prescription of lenses, prisms, exercises, or any physical, mechanical, physiological or psychological therapy

value: legend drugs do not include controlled substances other than Tramadol (Ultram)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The term does not include controlled substances (as defined in IC 35-48-1.1-7) other than Tramadol (Ultram).

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The board may authorize an optometrist holding a certificate issued under this chapter to: (1) administer for therapeutic use; (2) dispense; or (3) prescribe; legend drugs that are included in the formulary established by the board under section 10 of this chapter

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist may not: (1) administer, dispense, or prescribe therapeutic legend drugs; or (2) dispense or prescribe diagnostic legend drugs; unless the optometrist is certified under this chapter.

dea_registration_required.quote: maintains a controlled substance registration under IC 35-48-3; may prescribe Tramadol (Ultram).

specialty_certification_types.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to a licensed optometrist who: (1) applies; and (2) successfully fulfills all the requirements of this chapter.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: The board may not establish standards concerning the practice of ocular telemedicine or ocular telehealth that are more restrictive than the standards that are set: (1) under this article; or (2) by rule and applicable to the practitioner's in-person ocular practice.
